questions.question: Why does the two-layer XOR model need a nonlinear activation?
options: Without it the composition is still affine
Two affine layers always separate XOR
Cross-entropy itself changes the prediction boundary
questions.explanation: The optimizer can change coefficients but cannot enlarge the affine function class. The activation supplies nonlinear intermediate features.
optionFeedback: The optimizer can change coefficients but cannot enlarge the affine function class. The activation supplies nonlinear intermediate features.
